info.title: Junction Client API
info.description:
This API follows the [JSON:API][jsonapi] specifation.

A suggested booking flow example:

1. Retrieve Places from `GET /places`.
2. Initiate a Trip Search with `POST /trips/searches` by specifying one Place as origin and another as destination. This will start an asynchronous process to find suitable trips.
3. Retrieve Trip results from `GET /trips/searches/{tripSearchId}/trips`.
4. Intiate an Offer Search with `POST /offers/searches` by specifying one or more Trips. This will start an asynchronous process to find suitable trips.
5. Retrieve Offer results from `GET /offers/searches/{offerSearchId}/offers`.
6. Create an Order wit `POST /orders` by specifyng one or more Offers.

[jsonapi]: https://jsonapi.org/
